notes.title: Content Update 8: Map updates, break room, performance improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791342/a2f0219315f9c6a92a5a642d161deb859b1c9f8e.jpg[/img]

The new Content Update 8 is now available! 
You can look forward to many new features, improvements and optimisations. 
Check out the changelog below: 

[h1][b]Highlights:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Map data updated to February 2024 and preparation for future regular map updates
[*] Extensive enhancements, improvements and bug fixes to the map loading system
[*] Break room with new objects added where employees can relax
[*] Significantly reduced office space required per employee, and now also taking into account the area of the office, kitchen, bathroom and break room
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Savegame size greatly reduced, which also fixes problems with the Steam Cloud (old savegames need to be saved once)
[*] Fleet number is now displayed for allocated bus parking spaces if set
[*] The shift schedule now shows how many missed assignments there are for that day
[*] Fixed a bug where some buses could not be used after a recall event in rare cases
[*] Many bug fixes and improvements in the E-Bus & Green Energy DLC
[/list]

[h1][b]Map:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Update of the map data to February 2024
[*] New delivery of map data: The map data is now no longer supplied via Steam, instead the required tiles are downloaded when starting a new game. This means that all regions no longer require a lump sum of 50GB of hard drive space, but only a few MB per city.
[*] Offline use: Once downloaded, cities are also available offline. In addition, the most popular cities are included so that a new game can always be started even without the Internet.
[*] Acceleration of loading time by providing cache data: The cached map data, which enables a map to be loaded in the shortest possible time, will now be made available to all players on our cache server. This means that if a city has already been loaded once by a player, the cache data will then be downloaded directly for all players, which greatly speeds up loading times for a new game.
[*] Data saving mode: If you have poor internet or limited data volume, you can activate this setting so that only the smaller OpenStreetMap raw data is downloaded and the new cache is not used. 
[*] Larger maps: The individual tiles are now approx. 4 times larger. For existing savegames, the old tile format is converted to the new one, so that the playing area is slightly larger. There are now 10 large instead of 20 small tile extensions possible, which significantly increases the total possible area.
[*] Map versioning per savegame: Existing savegames can either continue to be played with the old map version or be updated to the latest map version.
[*] Regular map updates in the future: By optimising our entire provisioning process, we will be able to offer map updates at regular intervals in the future.
[*] Loading stability improvements: The loading process has been fundamentally revised so that it has been fixed that the game could hang during loading (often at tile 24/49)
[*] New countries / regions: Lesser Antilles, La Réunion, Puerto Rico, Cayman Islands, Macao
[*] Fixed problems when loading island regions (e.g. Tenerife)
[*] Fixed green stripes on the map
[*] Transitions between previous region packs (e.g. Switzerland-Italy, Denmark-Sweden) are now possible without any problems
[*] Fixed a bug where water areas were sometimes not displayed on maps (e.g. in Gothenburg)
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some characters to be displayed incorrectly after reloading a map
[/list]

[h1]Performance:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved performance on the map through fundamental changes to the rendering system
[*] Fixed lags when zooming on maps with a large number of stops
[*] Improved performance through fundamental optimisations to the employee and bus system
[*] Improved performance with a high number of bus routes
[*] Fixed regular hangs at 1 minute intervals
[/list]

[h1]Map and stops:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The search on the map can now also be used to search for bus stops
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the letters entered when searching on the map to disappear again when typing
[*] Fixed a bug where a satisfaction of 0 was always displayed for some stops
[*] Fixed a bug where it was sometimes no longer possible to zoom in on the map after an expansion
[*] Fixed a bug that caused long stop names to cause a display error in the "Edit stop" form
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the radius of a stop to disappear
[/list]

[h1]Building:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused „Not reachable“ markers to appear for no reason
[*] Bus parking spaces can now also be built in halls with drag & drop
[*] Added scrollbar in the construction menu for small displays
[/list]

[h1]Employees:[/h1]

notes.title: Content Update 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791342/f6d0e0bdda8f0cc0f20257931df5b85639b72ead.png[/img]

In this update we have implemented some of your most requested features! We have also fixed many reported bugs. 

[b]New features: [/b]
- Size of the premises doubled
- 5 new bus access roads added to the site to avoid traffic jams
- Tasks (washing, refuelling, etc.) can now be ordered at the same time, even if no staff or items are available, and will be processed automatically afterwards
- Brazilian currency added
- Many new features in the shift plan

[b]Shift schedule:[/b]
- A desired vehicle group can now be stored per shift. The vehicles are grouped according to their size by default. However, it is also possible to create your own vehicle groups and thus group the buses according to your own wishes
- Added automatic assignment for bus drivers only
- Shift plan can now be deleted / reseted
- When automatically assigning bus drivers, the bus drivers with the lowest workload are now assigned first
- The expected passenger volume is now displayed in the shift plan
- When assigning bus drivers, it is now visible how many hours they have already been assigned in the previous 7 days
- 6 instead of 4 buses are now displayed per page

[b]Timetable:[/b]
- Travel times can now be copied for sub-schedules
- When adding stops to a line, the journey times will no longer be reset.
- For public service lines, the departure time can now be changed by a few minutes in order to create better connections to other lines
- In the timetable preview, the bus stops on the left are now permanently displayed, even if you scroll to the right

[b]Performance:[/b]
- General performance improvements in the company premises
- Performance at night improved
- Regular FPS drops in large savegames, especially with many passengers, have been fixed.
- After loading the game, in rare cases there was an extremely long hang, which is now fixed.
- Performance in the map view significantly improved
- Performance drop when opening the bus overview with a lot of buses on the map fixed - Freezes during autosave reduced

[b]Map:[/b]
- For the automatically generated return trip, the same stops as for the outward trip are no longer taken as fixed, but nearby stops are also taken into account, so that unnecessary detours and street side changes are avoided on the return trip
- Fixed a bug that caused buses to fly across the map in rare cases
- Point of Interests are now hidden later when zooming out
- In the line view, the gains or losses of a line are now displayed directly
- New public service lines are now generated when expanding the map
- Fixed a bug that if you clicked on a live bus and the next tour was a service tour, the end time of the service tour was wrong
- Countries are now sorted in each language when a new game is played
- Fixed bug with missing 0s at the beginning of postcodes
- City selection significantly improved in the new game in South Korea (Many thanks to @Ijnsena @PC28K @Haenyeon @Jaehyeong!)

[b]Build:[/b]
- When building, the required access points and blocked cells are now visually displayed.
- Workshops and washing facilities can no longer be deleted while they are in use
- Items are no longer automatically rotated on walls when this makes the items inaccessible
- Fixed a bug when building on the edge of the premises 

[b]Pathfinding:[/b]
- Fixed bug where staff could endlessly fail to find a path even though a new path was built
- Fixed bug that buses stopped in front of the parking space in newly built parking spaces in rare cases
- Bug fixed that buses drove to petrol stations / car washes / workshops that were not accessible at all
- Fixed a bug where buses did not disappear when exiting and blocked the exit
- Fixed bug that employees sometimes walked through the wall

[b]Other:[/b]
- Update to Unity 2022.2
- The camera in the company area can now be zoomed out further
- Pause is no longer automatically ended in the game
- Increase of rewards for the task to increase the line network 
- Turkish and Thai fonts added
- Added explanation of shortcuts when placing stickers in the paint shop
- Buses can now no longer have the same number plate
- Friendliness is now also shown in the staff overview
- Fixed a bug that in the bus detail view the next shift was not displayed correctly
- The day of the week of the next shift is now displayed in the bus detail view, if it is not the same day of the week
- Fixed a bug where the technical status was not updated in the Bus Detail view after a repair
